$comment: Vendor-neutral identity reveals, consumed by tools/build-unified-preset.mjs.
A stealth / preview label carries no structure a fingerprint can derive
("space-bunny" says nothing about MiniMax), so the reveal is declared once
here as DATA - never as a per-vendor "<source>:<model>" literal in code.
Builder: unions fingerprint(match) with fingerprint(canonical) and emits
assign["alias:<match>"] pointing at the canonical model's group. Runtime
(shared/unified.js): an unassigned id whose text contains a match token
resolves to that group (longest token wins), so every spelling any vendor
openrouter alpha-space-bunny-test - resolves with no new line anywhere.
match tokens are lowercase substrings, unique across entries; canonical must
already have a price group; evidence says why they are the same model.

aliases.note: MiniMax revealed on 2026-10-19 that Space Bunny was an early version of M3.1 Flash; opencode renamed the listing to minimax-m3.1-flash-free and deprecated space-bunny-free. Seen as opencode space-bunny(-free) plus stealth/space-bunny-alpha and alpha-space-bunny-test on the routers. Zen's free window ended 2026-10-22; the official list price still applies to that usage.
Earlier stealth reveal: ox-alpha and the x-preview-f listing were GLM 5.3 Flash under anonymous labels. These used to be per-vendor AUTHORED_FOLDS lines.
